title: Hybrid PV pipeline: safe integration and GPU readiness

facts.text: Implementation happens on a new integration branch in a separate worktree. Existing main, friend, and transformer branches and all existing private/untracked files remain unchanged. Only the parent performs Git operations.

Integrate fixed commits: friend 10f44a2, corrected transformer 4978745, and shared-contract transformer 5199b6d. Resolve known conflicts explicitly without restoring in-sample threshold selection or positional persistence.
Agents use artificial data only. They do not read AIL datasets, rent GPUs, upload data, or run real-data training. GPU/data execution remains with the data holder, subject to hosting approval.

The friend pipeline remains the baseline and default when no encoder checkpoint is supplied. Its date and capacity estimators are unchanged in this integration. No initial-capacity or accuracy improvement is claimed without later real evaluation.

With an approved frozen encoder checkpoint, baseline versus baseline-plus-compact-embedding features is selected only inside the same customer-level inner CV using the complete challenge score. Any projection, imputation and scaling is fitted inside each training fold.

All comparison arms accept identical outer split files and emit the shared out-of-fold contract. Paired comparisons reject different customer-to-fold assignments. Existing corrected standalone transformer evaluation is retained, without duplicate obsolete evaluator paths.

Both feature sources derive from validated epoch-based measurements, preserving customer string IDs, missing-observation masks and absolute energy scale. Fixed UTC+1 physical features and Zurich calendar encoder features are explicitly derived from the same epochs.

A new pretraining command uses only explicitly supplied unlabelled training/validation customers and rejects overlap with an exclusion set of labelled/evaluation IDs. It streams or samples windows across customers and seasons, changes masks during training, and computes reconstruction normalization from visible observations only.

Pretraining supports CPU and CUDA, optional supported mixed precision, and resumable checkpoints containing model, optimizer, any scheduler/scaler, RNG, sampler and progress state. Checkpoints record preprocessing, model configuration, input identity and schema version.

The initial readiness run uses the existing 110k-parameter architecture. A fixed approximately615k candidate may be configured for a later controlled comparison; no large model sweep, fine-tuning feature option or architecture search is included now.

The saved hybrid model explicitly references its encoder artifact and fitted feature transformations. Export uses an exact-file allowlist, and offline inference reloads the complete selected procedure and emits both challenge CSV files. No actual data-derived model enters Git history.

Readiness requires the integrated regression suite plus an actual artificial-data run through pretraining, resume, nested model selection, export and offline inference. Baseline invariance, leakage exclusion, shared folds and reload prediction consistency are checked. Actual CUDA throughput/memory and real AIL scores remain explicitly unverified until run by the data holder.
